text:
lina: Heads-up: capacity alert — several GPU nodes in eu-central are failing post-join with KMS decrypt errors and odd egress routing.
omar: Saw that. Packet capture shows traffic for keystore endpoint going to legacy NAT fleet, not the keystore proxy nodes.
kevin: Which firewall rule change might have flipped routing? We rolled a deny-by-default for subnet egress last night.
sanjay: The deny worked, but a new tag `keystore:trust` was required by the keystore-proxy policy. New instances launched without the tag because the new launch template omitted TagSpecifications.
opsbot: Alert: keystore-decrypt-errors 7% (eu-central) over 10m. Autoscaler paused: 18 pending GPU joins.
lina: Quick mitigation proposal: 1) tmp allow rule for keystore proxy CIDR -> allow decrypt path 2) patch LT to include TagSpecifications for keystore:trust 3) slope audit exporter to 20% to reduce NAT egress during catch-up.
omar: Agreed. Temp rule command: `terraform apply -target=module.firewall.aws_security_group_rule.keystore-temp` (TTL 90m).
kevin: I'll add TagSpecifications to launch-template v14 and roll forward two canary ASGs, then cascade. Ensure `PropagateAtLaunch=true`.
sanjay: Security checklist: any temp allow must be logged and attested. secbot, can you pre-approve an exception for 90m?
secbot: Exception approved: INFRA-5012. Condition: attach ticket + auditor email and auto-revoke at 90 minutes.
opsbot: Mitigation applied: firewall-temp-open keystore-proxy (eu-central), audit-sampler set to 20% for region, canary LT rolled.
lina: Metrics: KMS 5xxs dropping, node join rate recovering. Good.
kevin: Follow-ups: 1) add autoscaler preflight that validates TagSpecifications on LT 2) add CI test that launches a small instance and asserts tags propagated 3) include cost delta from audit sampling and NAT egress in PM.
omar: Initial cost estimate: sampling to 20% trims ~0.6TB/hr egress (~$48/hr) while temp allow is active. Will refine after 2h.
sanjay: Also add a gate in the tag-migration job to fail if any ASG uses LT without `PropagateAtLaunch=true`.
lina: Filing PM stub INFRA-5012 now and will ping compliance. Good catch everyone.
opsbot: Monitoring: will auto-remove temp rule once keystore-decrypt-errors < 0.5% for 30m or after 90m.
kevin: Nice work. I'll open PRs for LT fix and autoscaler preflight.
